531401.name: Machine Gun
531401.description: Fires a Machine Gun at a single Nikke, dealing damage.

531402.name: Launch Raptures
531402.description: Indivilia summons Raptures. The summoned Raptures cannot be auto-targeted, and will proceed to self-destruct, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

531405.name: Point Laser
531405.description:
Fires lasers from body and pincers, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
The pincers can be destroyed.

531408.name: Overcharge
531408.description: Enhances her body, temporarily becoming immune to debuffs.

531410.name: Tail Laser
531410.description: Fires powerful lasers from the tail, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

531411.name: Pincer Wave
531411.description: Shoots a powerful laser from its pincer, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

531412.name: Super Quiver Blade
531412.description:
Whips all Nikkes with her tail, dealing damage.
Indivilia generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Super Quiver Blade. While the barrier is up, only Iron Code Nikkes can deal damage.

531413.name: All-Range Laser
531413.description: Fires a laser from its Core, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

531415.name: Head Laser
531415.description: Fires a powerful laser beam, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

531416.name: Head Rush
531416.description: Strikes with her head, piercing through cover and dealing damage to all Nikkes.

531419.name: Needle Projectile
531419.description:
Fires the needle missiles from both sides of its head, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Needle missiles can be intercepted.
